subject: SOC2 renewal — evidence scope & retention policy decision
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian.park@customersys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 renewal — evidence scope & retention question

Hi Rachel,

We’re kicking off our internal prep for the August 15 renewal and the security team asked for clarification on two items: 1) What evidence package Redwood will provide for SOC 2 recert, and 2) whether extending the audit-log retention window to 365 days (from our current 90) is possible, and what the cost/contract implications are.

A couple of specifics from our side: we may be migrating a subset of infra to a new region which could add around ~30% additional token/seat usage during the migration month — would that affect the retention pricing or require a capacity addendum?

Can you send your evidence manifest and a short note on retention options (90/180/365) and whether any amendment is required to the MSA?

Thanks — Julian
Julian Park
Security Manager, Customersys Inc.
security-team@customersys.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@customersys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal — evidence scope & retention question

Hi Julian —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can support expanded retention and a consolidated evidence bundle for your recert, but there are two tracks depending on how you want to proceed:

- Standard renewal bundle (no retention change): we provide the SOC 2 attestation, policy summary, and a curated evidence manifest (logs/snapshots/sample runs) for the audit window. No contract amendment required.
- Retention expansion (90 -> 365 days): this requires a simple contract amendment for data residency/retention term and a modest monthly storage/ingestion surcharge. There is also a one-time migration/ingest fee if historical log backfill is requested.

Preliminary numbers (ballpark): 365d retention = +$2,400/month for the Customersys account (est.), one-time backfill: $3,200. Capacity uplift during migration (+30% usage) can be handled under Dedicated burst or Reserved seats — we can quote a temporary burst rate or propose a short-term top-up to your committed capacity so unit pricing stays stable.

I attached the SOC2 summary and an evidence manifest we use for recertification. If you want, we can: 1) draft the amendment for signature, 2) schedule a 30m intake to validate log selectors and retention scope, and 3) run a one-week pilot to measure storage delta on a representative log slice.

Attachments: soc2-summary-2028.pdf (summary of control changes since last attestation), evidence-manifest-2028.xlsx (sample file list + how we map evidence to controls)

Proposed next step: confirm whether you want the 365d option + backfill. If yes, I’ll loop in Legal and Pricing to produce the amendment and a final cost schedule.

If helpful, we can also offer the first month of extended retention at no charge as a short pilot.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal — evidence scope & retention question (internal)

Rachel — quick internal note from Legal/Pricing:

- Amendment: retention > 180 days should be a standard amendment (simple exhibit) that covers retention SLA, egress/export window, and an agreed one-time backfill fee if Customersys requests historical data. Legal suggests limiting the increased retention to logs tied to attestation controls (authn/authorization, admin actions, and audit pipelines) rather than entire raw telemetry to keep costs predictable.
- Pricing: propose a fixed monthly retention surcharge for 365d (we quoted $2,400, ok to round to $2,500 on contract), one-time backfill cap at $3,500. Offer first-month pilot free.
- Capacity/Seat uplift during migration: recommend offering a temporary burst top-up invoiceable at committed seat rate + 10% rather than changing the main committed capacity line-item. Simpler operationally.

Action items: Marcus — can you validate the estimated storage delta and confirm if the $2,400 number looks reasonable for Customersys current usage? Laura — please draft the amendment exhibit with the warranty and exit clauses. Rachel — once Marcus confirms, I'll approve the pricing and Legal will prepare a short amendment doc for signature (DocuSign).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@customersys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal — evidence scope & retention question

Julian — following up with the plan and formal quote.

Per your ask, attached are: soc2-summary-2028.pdf and the evidence-manifest-2028.xlsx with the specific log selectors we’ll include in the bundle. We recommend scoping retention to the attestation-relevant log categories (auth logs, admin audit, config changes, and pipeline audit traces).

Final proposal summary:
- Retention: 365 days for attestation-relevant logs
- Monthly surcharge: $2,500 (fixed)
- One-time historical backfill (optional): $3,500 cap
- Migration month capacity bump (+30% usage): handled as a temporary burst at committed-seat rate + 10% so we do not need to change your main commitment for long term
- Pilot: first month of retention expansion free; we’ll measure delta and reconcile prior to billing for month two

Next steps (suggested):
1) Approve the retention option (reply OK to this thread)
2) Sign the short amendment (DocuSign link below once Legal uploads)
3) Schedule a 30m intake next week to confirm log selectors and run the backfill pilot (if requested)

Links / attachments:
- Amendment draft (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-evidence
- DocuSign (will be sent after Legal finalizes): https://app.docusign.com/amend/0L9K
- Attachments: soc2-summary-2028.pdf; evidence-manifest-2028.xlsx; audit-log-sample.csv (sample row format)

If that all looks good I’ll kick off Legal to prepare the DocuSign and Ops to schedule the intake. Thanks — looking forward to closing this out ahead of your renewal window.
